item.title: [ 34] Wife beater MAGA Max Miller posts nude image and personal details of his 2-year-old daughter
item.description:
Miller's attorney blames a missed page for the leak as Sen. Bernie Moreno calls it grotesque and Miller now asks for his own House ethics probe before an Aug. 10 ballot deadline.

https://tiffinohio.net/posts/miller-nude-image-2-year-old-daughter-evidence-dump/

Moments before he posted a link to hundreds of messages, recordings and images from his divorce, U.S. Rep. Max Miller told a livestream audience why he was doing it.

“This isn’t about defending myself,” the Ohio Republican said. “I’m speaking up as a father, trying to protect our daughter.”

The folder he shared Sunday with his nearly 60,000 followers on X contained an image of that daughter, who is 2 years old, nude, CNN reported Tuesday. The image was publicly available for at least a day before it was taken down.

Miller’s personal attorney, Aaron Minc, has taken responsibility for it. “Unfortunately, I missed the last three pages of a 40+ page document with sensitive content,” Minc said in a statement to CNN. “It was completely unintentional and a mistake. The moment I discovered the issue on Monday morning, I corrected the file immediately.”

Minc said he made multiple passes through the material to strip out sensitive details, including the child’s name. CNN reported that an earlier version of the public file it reviewed included the child’s name dozens of times, along with payment records to medical providers and several images of her.

“I am truly sorry to Congressman Miller, Ms. Moreno, both of their families, and, especially, to their daughter,” Minc said. “I deeply regret the mistake.”

item.title: [129] Mamdani Does the Big Funny: Centrally Planned Grocery Stores
item.description:
> https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/aug/02/mamdani-grocery-store-plan-new-york

Carlos Collado, a Dominican immigrant who owns five independent grocery stores in the Bronx and Manhattan, has succeeded over the last three decades despite obstacles that he blames on local and state governance.

His stores have faced an increase in shoplifting, he said. The city has provided tax benefits to big corporations that opened grocery stores and took business away from his.

Now, he says, New York’s new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, will make it even harder for him and other grocery store and bodega owners to succeed because of his plan to open five city-owned grocers. The mayor announced additional details about the stores this week, which he said will offer produce, meat and seafood for 30% less than typical retail prices.

Existing businesses will not be able to compete, Collado and some others say. But there is also support for Mamdani’s venture, saying that the stores will bring much-need food options into areas of New York city sorely lacking in grocery shops and help with a crisis in soaring food prices that hits some of the city’s most vulnerable families the hardest.

Food costs in the United States have soared in recent years. In June, the average price of ground chuck beef was almost $7 a pound, an 83% increase over June 2016, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. In the New York-New Jersey area, the consumer price index for food increased 33% from 2015 to 2024, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of St Louis.

An off-duty state trooper and an armed civilian have been praised for their 'heroic' actions after saving lives during the terrifying In-N-Out shooting in Idaho.

The courageous men, who have not been named, both fired shots at the suspect, Chad Williams, after he opened fire at the restaurant on Saturday around 2.30pm in Twin Falls, Police Chief Matthew Hicks said.

'We want to take a moment and commend the actions of the off-duty officer and the citizen and their heroic action to stop this incident,' Hicks said during a press conference on Sunday.

'We believe their actions helped drive the suspect away from the scene, preventing further casualties.'

The civilian was seen pointing his gun at Williams while he aimed a camouflaged AR-style rifle at innocent customers and employees in the drive-thru and parking lot, footage showed.

Williams, 24, killed three people, including a beloved employee, the franchise owner revealed.

Seven others were left injured in the rampage. Two of them were taken to the hospital and later released, the agency said.

Three others were stable after the shooting, and the remaining two have been left in critical condition.
